TestDelegateAddedInCallbackNotExecutedAfterIntermediateCancelledDelegate()

Tests that delegates added from inside a scheduled callback don't get executed when the scheduled callback cancels a prior intermediate task.

Delegate 1 - Added at the start. Delegate 2 - Added at the start, cancelled by Delegate 1. Delegate 3 - Added during Delegate 1 callback, should not get executed.
